original_card.acceptance_gate: An exact arbitrary-input identity, source/target frame availability and restoration at the chosen cut, plus the complete channel+correction+idle/hosting bill or an explicit favorable bound. The native channel alone is not a supplier. A scoped local result may be retained without a complete supplier. Expanding it into further construction rounds requires the family-level budget and obligation gate in research-family-status.md; an optimistic passing relaxation alone is not acceptance.

open_questions.question: Can two native calls be interleaved so that helpers of both are resident in one interior frame, and does a pure pair then exist across the calls?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Proposition 6.3 shows consecutive calls never share a pair; interleaving is the case it does not cover.
open_questions.first_step: Merge two call schedules where their local gates commute, compute the pure lattices of the class at the merged frame, and read the Gram divisors.
open_questions.blocked_by: A legal commuting merge of two native programs and the complete invoice of the merged schedule.

open_questions.question: Is there a literal equal-target class that mixes caller roles and helper inputs?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Section 6 treats classes inside one level; a mixed class would need its own statement.
open_questions.first_step: List the declared endpoint targets of caller roles and helper inputs of one composite word and intersect them.
open_questions.blocked_by: A literal composite word with its helper inputs declared as roles.

open_questions.question: Does the unit-divisor count of the criterion equal the rank over Q at every cut of every native helper group of the #6805 word?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Theorem 5.1 counts unit divisors; a count by rank over Q could overcount where a divisor is not a unit.
open_questions.first_step: Run the pure-lattice computation of verify.py over all frames and cuts of one helper group and compare divisors with ranks.
open_questions.blocked_by: Compute time only; no new mathematics is expected.
